Kurt M. STEINER, holder of a provisional Czecho-slovakian
passport in which he is described as "without nationality,"
was born in Saxony on September 16, 1912 of an Austrian
father. After the Great War, applicant's family removed
to that territory now known as Sudetenland, recently
annexed by the German Reich.

Steiner has Jewish blood in his veins and since the
promulgation of the anti-Semitic measures by Hitler, he
has no desire to assume German/nationality which, prior to the
introduction of these measures, he could have done with
no difficulty.

With reference to the letter of destruction of the officer
i/c Special Branch on the subject of one Kurt . Steiner, I
have to report that nothing is known to the Shanghai Municipal
Police in this gentleman's antecedents.

Mr. Steiner is a young man of Czecho-Slovakian national-
ity who was born in Germany of an Austrian father about 31
years ago. After the war in 1918, that part of Austria
in which he and his family were then residing changed hands
and became Czecho-Slovakian territory. The Steiner family
came to Shanghai some years ago and young Steiner received
several years schooling at the Shanghai American School on
Avenue Petain. His father, Mr. Steiner, now deceased,
represented the firm of Steiner & Co., Manufacturers' Represent-
atives, in Tientsin Road and until recently, Kurt Steiner was
employed by the company.

About three or four months ago he married a Russian lady
according to Chinese law, after which he proceeded to Nanking
and commenced business on his own trading under the name
K. . Steiner & Co.

He is looked upon as a very likeable individual and he
moves freely among German circles. The reason that
he has applied to be allowed to bear a naturalised German,
it is said, is because he is a German at heart and feels more
at home among things German.

Subject (in full) Solomon Schiffmann alias Solomon Jager.

Made by F.S. ________________ Forwarded by ________________

With reference to the memo of the Officer i/c Special Branch
dated May 9, 1934, on the subject of one Solomon Schiffmann
residing at No. 2 Studley Avenue, enquiries regarding the
antecedents and character of this individual reveal the following
information:-

Solomon Schiffmann, Austrian Jew, was born in November 1891,
at Drohobycz, Galicia. In 1914, at the outbreak of the Great
War, Solomon Schiffmann being an Austrian citizen was mobilized
and sent to the Russian front with one of the Austrian Infantry
Regiments. Some time during the latter part of September, 1914,
he was wounded and taken prisoner of war by the Russians and
consequently sent to Spassk, a small provincial town in the Riazine
Province. In 1920 he was freed from the war prisoners' camp
and proceeded to Vladivostock where he managed to obtain employment
with a certain American shipping firm as a clerk, in which capacity
he worked until 1923 when he left for Shanghai. Upon his
arrival in Shanghai he was employed with the Maison Arcus as a
bookkeeper for a period of two years and later joined the firm
of S. Bohr & Matlow, Ltd., where he is still employed.

It appears, that as a result of the Great War, the town of
Drohobycz as well as a large portion of Austrian Galicia was
alloted to Poland, thus all people residing there automatically
became Polish subjects and were issued with Polish passports. The
Polish passport in Solomon Schiffmann's possession was issued to
him in 1920 in Vladivostock upon his release from the war prisoners
camp and since that time has been renewed in 1923 in Harbin.

Nothing detrimental is known by this office regarding this
individual.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
W. MacLaren

关于特务科主管官员1934年5月9日就居住在斯德利路（Studley Avenue）2号的 Solomon Schiffmann 一事发出的备忘录，经查询该个人的背景和品格，获悉以下信息：-

Solomon Schiffmann，奥地利犹太人，1891年11月出生于加利西亚的德罗霍贝奇（Drohobycz）。1914年大战爆发时，作为奥地利公民的 Solomon Schiffmann 被征召入伍，随奥地利步兵团之一被派往俄国前线。1914年9月下旬的某个时候，他受伤并被俄军俘虏，随后被送往梁赞省（Riazine Province）的一个小镇斯帕斯克（Spassk）。1920年，他从战俘营获释，前往符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock），在那里设法在一家美国航运公司找到了一份职员工作，他一直工作到1923年离开前往上海。抵达上海后，他在 Maison Arcus 公司担任簿记员两年，后来加入 S. Bohr & Matlow, Ltd. 公司，至今仍受雇于此。

看来，由于大战的结果，德罗霍贝奇镇以及奥地利加利西亚的大部分地区被划归波兰，因此所有居住在那里的人自动成为波兰臣民，并获得波兰护照。Solomon Schiffmann 持有的波兰护照是他1920年在符拉迪沃斯托克从战俘营获释时签发的，此后于1923年在哈尔滨续期。

本部门对该个人没有任何不利了解。

特务科主管官员。

women, owners of a "Beauty Parlour" in Mukden. After obtaining
the money Samuel decamped and was believed to have come to
Shanghai, although he could not be located at the time. This
same individual was arrested in the French Concession, Shanghai
on February 7, 1934 for unlawful entry and causing material

Subject (in full) Dr. Edward J.A.H. Rudolph.

Made by D.S. Sansom Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕

With reference to the application dated March 20, 1936,
from Dr. Edward J.A.H. Rudolph to the Shanghai Municipal Police,
requesting that he be given a certificate of good conduct cover-
ing the period of his residence in Shanghai, I have to state that
there is nothing in the records of the Shanghai Municipal Police
prejudicial to this gentleman's character.

Dr. Rudolph, a chemist, of German nationality, arrived in
Shanghai on December 24, 1932, having come direct from Germany
on contract with the Elektrochemische Werke Munch A.C., a firm
which is affiliated to Melchers & Co. He remained in Shanghai
until November 14, 1934, when he sailed direct for Germany aboard
the s.s. "Oder", having resigned from the firm on his own account.
Throughout his stay in Shanghai he resided at 100 Tifeng Road and
at 591/102 Bubbling Well Road.

Dr. Rudolph belongs to a wealthy and respectable family, and
his conduct in Shanghai was above reproach.

鲁道夫博士系德国籍化学家，于1932年12月24日抵达上海，此前直接从德国前来，与隶属于美最时洋行 (Melchers & Co.) 的 Elektrochemische Werke Munch A.C. 公司签有合约。他在上海停留至1934年11月14日，随后因个人原因辞去该公司职务，乘坐“奥得”号 (s.s. "Oder") 轮船直接驶往德国。在沪期间，他一直居住在提封路 (Tifeng Road) 100号和静安寺路 (Bubbling Well Road) 591/102号。

REPORT
Date December 10, 1936.

Subject Eliazar Moiseyevitch SAMSONOVICH; communication from the Russian
Emigrants' Committee.

Made by D.P.S. Henchman Forwarded by J. Bryan 451

With reference to the attached communication I have to
state that E.M. Samsonovich, Russian Jew, born at Verhneudinsk,
on 17th August 1901, came to China with his wife, Ada Samsonovich,
in May, 1925. By profession he is a textile engineer. He
is registered at the offices of the Russian Emigrants' Committee
and although this organisation has no record of anything
detrimental to his character, he is well known to Police in
Shanghai. On 28th March, 1934 he was convicted on charges
of fraud and issuing worthless cheques and was sentenced by
the 2nd Shanghai Special District Court to a fine of $40 or
twenty days' imprisonment; on 31st December 1935 he was charged
with forgery but was acquitted by the 2nd Shanghai Special
District Court.

Since his arrival in China Samsonovich has visited
Hankow and Tientsin in which places he carried on business as
a merchant. In Shanghai, in 1930, he operated the Far
Eastern Loan and Finance Co. at 22 Nanking Road and when that
business failed he found employment as an expert embroiderer,
first at Messrs. Elabroideries, then at Patersons Mackenzie &
Co. and finally at Master & Co. While in Shanghai Samsonovich
has resided at various addresses both in the French Concession
and in the International Settlement, his present address is
160 Hungjao Road.

It should be noted that E. M. Samsonovich is the son of
Moses E. Samsonovich who was engaged in arms and drug traffic
while in Shanghai and who was arrested in Hongkong in January
1925 for being in possession of morphia. Moses Samsonovich
has been in Brazil since 1930.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE ... 10 DEC 1936 ...）

D.C. (Special Branch) D. P. S.
（签名：J. Henchman）

事由 埃利亚扎尔·莫伊谢耶维奇·萨姆索诺维奇（Eliazar Moiseyevitch SAMSONOVICH）；俄国难民委员会来函。

呈报人 D.P.S. Henchman 转呈人 J. Bryan 451

关于随附来函，本人须声明，E.M. 萨姆索诺维奇，俄籍犹太人，1901年8月17日出生于上乌丁斯克（Verhneudinsk），于1925年5月携妻子阿达·萨姆索诺维奇（Ada Samsonovich）来到中国。他的职业是纺织工程师。他在俄国难民委员会办事处登记，虽然该组织没有关于他品行不端的记录，但他在上海为警方所熟知。1934年3月28日，他因欺诈和开具空头支票罪名成立，被上海第二特区法院判处罚金40元或监禁二十天；1935年12月31日，他被控伪造文书，但被上海第二特区法院宣判无罪。

自抵达中国以来，萨姆索诺维奇曾前往汉口和天津，在这些地方从事商人业务。在上海，1930年，他在南京路22号经营远东贷款金融公司（Far Eastern Loan and Finance Co.），该生意失败后，他受雇为专业刺绣师，先是在 Elabroideries 公司，然后在 Patersons Mackenzie & Co. 公司，最后在 Master & Co. 公司。在上海期间，萨姆索诺维奇居住在法租界和国际公共租界内的多个地址，他目前的地址是虹桥路160号。

需要注意的是，E. M. 萨姆索诺维奇是摩西·E·萨姆索诺维奇（Moses E. Samsonovich）的儿子，后者在上海期间从事军火和毒品交易，并于1925年1月在香港因持有吗啡被捕。摩西·萨姆索诺维奇自1930年以来一直在巴西。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 ... 1936年12月10日 ...）

D.C. (特务科) D. P. S.
（签名：J. Henchman）

Re Mr. Eliazer M. Samsonovich

I beg to inform you that Mr. E. M. Samsonovich arrived in China
from England in May 1925. Mr. E. M. Samsonovich and his wife Mrs. Ada
Samsonovich resided in Shanghai, Hankow and Tientsin.

red at this Committee and there are no records against him. He is
of good conduct and does not belong to any political group or orga-
nization whose principles are against Law, Order and Government.
Mr. E. M. Samsonovich is a Merchant by profession has been
residing in China for 10 years and during that time has never lost
his reason or applied to mendicancy, and has always been able to
support himself.
